_why.week.FRAME_DX_KM: 4.6 km west puts 4 more Halton GO trains on screen (6 to 2 off the left edge) and loses none in Durham
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots still read as distinct dots on every line after VP9 and cut strobe from 0.0035 to 0.0021
_why.day.BUS_HALO_ALPHA: 0.07 takes the faint glow off the dense subway lines, GO dots read the same, strobe down to 0.0020
_why.BASE_ROADS_GAIN: 0.75 quiets the dense road grid of a 115 km frame so the thin GO corridors stand out; roads still show after VP9
_why.rush.FRAME_DX_KM: same 4.6 km west as the day: 2 to 4 more Halton GO trains on screen in every rush still, at most 1 lost east
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 12 min cuts strobe to 0.00215 and makes the sparse GO corridors legible on a phone; no line fuses into white
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: the day's 1.6 px dots, set by hand: the rush pass has no dot knobs; measured rush strobe 0.00215 to 0.00130
_why.rush.BUS_HALO_ALPHA: the day's 0.07 halo, set by hand with the dots (no rush halo knob); dots stay small and sharp after VP9
